items.exampleEn: My little brother put stickers all over his notebook.
items.exampleZh: 我弟弟在他的筆記本上貼滿了貼紙。

items.exampleEn: This button deletes everything, so be careful.
items.exampleZh: 這個按鈕會刪除所有東西，所以要小心。

items.exampleEn: Change your password every few months.
items.exampleZh: 每隔幾個月就換一次密碼。

items.exampleEn: The bank teller counted the money twice.
items.exampleZh: 銀行行員把錢數了兩次。

items.exampleEn: Her speech was fluent and clear.
The photocopy is not very clear.
The new network at our school is very fast.
items.exampleZh: 我們學校的新網路速度很快。

items.exampleEn: Our teacher announced that the test was canceled.

items.sentenceEn: Please don't put stickers on the walls.

items.audioEn: The library will announce the winners of the poster contest at noon on Friday.
items.audioZh: 圖書館將在星期五中午公布海報比賽的得獎者。

items.sentenceEn: There was only one teller working this morning.
items.sentenceZh: 今天早上只有一位行員在上班。

items.stemEn: You should never tell anyone your ____.
items.stemZh: 你永遠不應該告訴任何人你的密碼。

items.stemEn: The pilot will ____ when we can take off our seat belts.
items.stemZh: 機長會宣布我們什麼時候可以解開安全帶。

items.passageEn: Yesterday I went to the bank to open an account. The teller was very helpful, and she was fluent in three languages. She asked me to choose a password for online banking. Then she made a photocopy of my identity card. On the teller's desk, there was a sticker that said, "Please turn off your phone." Suddenly, a man announced that the bank's computer network was not working, so everyone had to wait. While I waited, I deleted some old photos from my phone.
items.passageZh: 昨天我去銀行開戶。行員很熱心，而且能流利地說三種語言。她請我設定網路銀行的密碼，接著影印了我的身分證。行員的桌上貼著一張貼紙，寫著「請關閉手機」。突然，一位男士宣布銀行的電腦網路故障了，所以大家都得等。等待的時候，我刪掉了手機裡一些舊照片。

options: 有位客人在櫃台前吵了很久
行員們都去開一個很長的會
銀行的電腦網路故障了

items.promptZh: 這家公司在全國都有銷售網。
referenceEn: The company has a sales network across the country.
This company has a sales network all over the country.
rubricZh: network 表示「網路、銷售網、路網」，例如 a sales network 等說法
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式等）

items.promptZh: 他在日本住了五年，日文說得很流利。
referenceEn: He lived in Japan for five years, so he is fluent in Japanese.
After five years in Japan, he speaks fluent Japanese.
rubricZh: 用 fluent 表示「流利的」（例如 is fluent in…、speaks fluent… 等）
